issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 04 uses an alias (regierungsbezirk AS District) which renames the required column into English. The problem statement explicitly instructs students not to rename columns with AS unless requested. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected output column name and may cause automated checks to fail or produce unexpected feedback.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the alias in the solution so the column remains named regierungsbezirk (e.g. SELECT regierungsbezirk, SUM(einwohner_w), SUM(einwohner_m) ...). Alternatively, update the problem instructions to explicitly allow this alias if that was intended.
